_comment: Models DroneForge needs. 'url' = public download (resumable). sha256 + size are checked after every download. Add a mirror with --from <folder or URL base>.

models.name: da3_metric.weights.safetensors
models.what: Depth Anything 3 metric depth, weights (1.3 GB): the depth model behind obstacles, the map and the VO anchors

models.name: da3_metric.onnx
models.what: Depth Anything 3 metric depth, graph (must sit next to the .weights.safetensors)

models.name: superpoint.onnx
models.what: SuperPoint feature extractor (visual odometry), LightGlue-ONNX v1.0.0

models.name: superpoint_lightglue.onnx
models.what: LightGlue matcher (visual odometry); LightGlue-ONNX v1.0.0 asset superpoint_lightglue_fused_cpu.onnx, saved under this name

optional.name: buffalo_l
optional.what: InsightFace buffalo_l (GCS vision bar FACE REC), unpacked into ~/.insightface/models/buffalo_l

manual.name: detect.onnx
manual.what: Optional YOLOv8 / YOLO11 COCO detector for the GCS DETECT button (output [1, 84, N]). Without it DETECT uses the depth obstacles only. Export your own: yolo export model=yolov8n.pt format=onnx
